jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you will contribute to the development and implementation of our global workplace strategy and translate business requirements into effective, future-focused workplace solutions. Working closely with internal specialists and external partners, you will bring together the expertise needed to shape solutions aligned with our global Love Your Workplace concept. You will lead workplace projects from early location analysis and space planning through workplace programming, where data, business requirements, work patterns and stakeholder needs are translated into clear workplace requirements and design briefs. The role combines workplace project leadership, strategic space management, data analytics, and stakeholder engagement, with a strong focus on workplace experience and performance.

**Welcome to Global Real Estate & Workplace Management

**You'll be part of Workplace Development, a team within Global Real Estate & Workplace Management (GREWM). Together, we're responsible for developing and evolving Love Your Workplace, our global workplace concept for how offices are designed, used, and experienced across the organization. We collaborate with colleagues across Facilities Management, IT, People & Culture, Procurement, Security, and business leadership to create workplaces that support collaboration, wellbeing, productivity, and sustainability.

As a team, we bring together diverse professional backgrounds and expertise to continuously improve workplace experience for our colleagues around the world. You'll join a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where you'll have opportunities to influence workplace solutions across our global portfolio.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• Implementing and managing global workplace concepts, standards and policies, while driving the adoption and continued reinforcement of activity-based working

• Translating organizational, functional, and employee requirements into practical workplace solutions and a clear project-specific vision

• Leading workplace projects from pre-project planning and location assessment through programming, design, delivery, implementation, handover, and post-occupancy follow-up

• Advising on space requirements and supporting real estate and lease-selection decisions through test fits and workplace data

• Leading and coordinating the development of project briefs, zoning principles, test fits, layouts, and design plans in collaboration with decision-makers and workplace ambassadors

• Applying and continuously improving occupancy and capacity-planning methodologies

• Identifying opportunities for right-sizing, consolidation, and portfolio optimization, and supporting workplace business cases and project prioritization

• Supporting in collecting and analyzing real estate, people, occupancy and utilization data and converting findings into actionable recommendations

• Using and contributing to the development of workplace KPI and benchmarking frameworks to support evidence-based decisions

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Bring strong workplace project leadership skills, combined with strategic workplace understanding and solid end-to-end project management experience, preferably from workplace, office fit-out or implementation of ABW projects.

• Understand workplace from both a built-environment and user perspective and are passionate about creating great workplace experiences

• Are curious and ambitious about the future of the workplace and how workplace solutions can continuously evolve to meet changing business and user needs

• Have strong analytical capabilities within occupancy, capacity, utilization and portfolio planning, and can communicate complex findings clearly

• Understand how workplace performance can be evaluated through user experience, occupancy, utilization and other workplace performance measures, and use these insights to continuously improve solutions

• Can effectively coordinate multiple projects and priorities at the same time

• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels and cultures

• Communicate clearly and confidently, whether discussing workplace concepts with senior leaders or supporting users through workplace change

• Enjoy working collaboratively and influencing outcomes through engagement and partnership rather than formal authority

• Are structured, proactive and able to navigate a complex international organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Are willing to undertake occasional business travel, primarily within Central Europe and the UK

• building strong relationships with senior sponsors, regional and local stakeholders, business leaders and cross-functional partners

**Maybe you've read the above and can see you have some transferable skills

**Even if your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still like to hear from you. We recognize that valuable skills and perspectives come from different industries and backgrounds. Finding the right colleague matters more than a specific location, so we're open to candidates based in Denmark, London, or Warsaw. If you're excited about creating great workplace experiences and believe you can contribute to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application as soon as possible. We'll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we've found the right candidate

**Join a global leader in renewable energy

**Ørsted is a growing green energy major and a global leader in climate action. Here, you'll contribute to creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. You'll work alongside skilled colleagues in an international environment where trust, collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday life. We offer opportunities to grow your career while helping shape solutions that have a positive impact on both people and society.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Help deliver life-saving vaccines worldwide. Join Bavarian Nordic’s Global Planning team and coordinate supply across our global CMO network.

**About The Role

**You will be the operational link between Bavarian Nordic and assigned CMOs, coordinating materials, products, systems, documentation, and supply plans to enable compliant manufacturing and reliable vaccine supply.

The role offers broad end-to-end exposure to external manufacturing, working across internal teams and external partners to solve operational challenges and continuously improve supply planning and execution.

This 2-year position, reporting to the Senior CMO Planning Manager, is based in Denmark, with a hybrid setup near Kvistgaard or fully remote within Denmark. Travel is approximately 10–20%, mainly within Europe with occasional trips to the US.

**About The Team

**You will join a dedicated Global Planning team within our international Supply Chain organization. The role is highly cross-functional, connecting you with External Manufacturing, Quality, Packaging Artwork, Logistics, Production, Procurement, and Finance and giving you broad exposure to end-to-end pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will ensure operational readiness and smooth execution across assigned CMOs by:

• Coordinating supply activities to deliver approved plans and manufacturing schedules

• Managing materials, samples, product flows, purchase orders, invoices, and manufacturing readiness

• Acting as the main supply chain contact for CMOs and aligning internal and external stakeholders

• Anticipating risks, resolving execution issues, and supporting compliant GMP operations

• Driving improvements that increase efficiency, transparency, and operational excellence

**Who You Are

**You understand supply chain operations, navigate complex manufacturing environments with confidence, and build effective relationships across functions and geographies.

You also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field

• At least 3 years of experience in supply chain, external manufacturing, planning, or a similar role in pharma, biotech, or life sciences

• Experience in GMP-regulated environments and knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Hands-on experience with ERP and quality management systems

• Fluent written and spoken English

• APICS certification such as CSCP or CPIM is an advantage

You are proactive, analytical, and comfortable taking ownership. You are able to connect the details with the bigger picture, collaborate well across cultures and functions, and look for smarter ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**Make a visible impact on the global supply of life-saving vaccines. You will gain end-to-end CMO exposure, influence important processes, and turn ideas into practical improvements in a growing, purpose-driven organization.

Beyond this, we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with colleagues across countries and functions

• Opportunities for professional development and broad business exposure

• Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Access to fitness discounts, massage scheme, and an active staff club with social and sporting events

**Ready to help keep life-saving vaccines moving?

**Apply through our designated application platform. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Help Us drive Data analytics and AI-Powered Business Transformation

**Are you passionate about data, analytics, and AI? Then you could be the one we are looking for.

**About the Role:

**We are looking for a skilled and proactive Data & AI Platform Engineer to help shape our next generation of digital capabilities.

In this role, you'll design and develop modern data platforms, integrations, and analytics solutions that empower automation, AI adoption and intelligent business processes across the organization.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, ERP specialists, process owners, BI developers, and application teams to transform data into actionable insights and create scalable solutions that unlock the value of AI.

This is more than a traditional data engineering role. You'll play a key part in building the infrastructure and capabilities that allow the business to leverage technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, machine learning, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics.

**What You'll Do

****Build the Foundation for AI

**

• Design, build, and maintain enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, and semantic models.

• Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that make trusted data available across the organization.

• Ensure data quality, governance, security, and documentation are embedded into all solutions.

• Drive data accessibility.

**Enable Intelligent Applications & Automation

**

• Develop integrations between Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure services, manufacturing systems, APIs, and external platforms to gather data.

• Support the development of AI-enabled applications and business solutions.

**Empower Analytics & Business Decisions

**

• Deliver trusted datasets for reporting, dashboards, and self-service analytics.

• Design scalable data models that support both operational reporting and AI-driven insights.

• Partner with business stakeholders to turn challenges into data-driven solutions.

• Promote best practices for data and AI adoption throughout the organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer, Application Developer, or similar role.

• Strong SQL and data modeling

• Understanding of modern data engineering principles, governance, and securit

• Experience with one or more technologies like Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or DBT, Azure Data Services, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python, C#, Databricks (optional)

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience building and maintaining cloud-based data platforms and integration solutions.

• Experience with scalable data architectures and modern data pipelines.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or other ERP platforms.

• Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio.

• Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or machine learning concepts.

• Experience exposing and managing enterprise data for AI consumption.

• Power BI experience.

**You ar****e someone who:

**

• Is passionate about solving business challenges with data and technology.

• Is curious about AI and emerging technologies.

• Can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Takes ownership and drives initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Enjoys collaborating across teams and influencing positive change

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping our organization's AI and data strategy.

• The opportunity to build platforms that enable AI, automation, analytics, and digital innovation.

• Hands-on experience with modern Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, and AI solutions.

• Significant influence on architecture, standards, and technology choices.

• Close collaboration with business and technology leaders.

• A flexible environment that encourages experimentation, learning, and innovation.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Do you enjoy keeping a team moving without getting in the way? Are you the kind of producer who loves making work life easier for your team through process? And are you also quite silly?

We're expanding one of our games and looking for a Senior Producer to help drive new content and features for our players. You'll work very closely with the executive producer and game director, supporting them in setting a clear production plan within time and budget constraints, while making sure the team has everything they need to do their best work.

You'll also be part of a cross-studio producer team where you can exchange ideas, challenge each other, and share knowledge and complementary skills.

**Here's What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Implement and refine production processes and tools, shaping how we work and grow as a studio

• Drive the project forward by removing roadblocks and keeping delivery dates realistic

• Facilitate the team’s day-to-day rhythm (stand-ups, planning, reviews, post-mortems)

• Plan updates, roadmaps, and marketing beats together with the leads, and communicate plans clearly to stakeholders

• Manage the project long-term: priorities, scope, timelines, risks, and follow-up

• Take on team and people responsibility, including 1:1s, development reviews, and salary conversations

Last, but not least: There's plenty of room to shape this role to fit you.

**Must-haves

**

• Experience going through at least one full game production cycle

• Experience as a producer on at least one shipped game

• Experience with live service and online games

• Experience working with external stakeholders

• A deep understanding of the game development process

• A strong belief in nurturing team wellbeing because a sustainable pace and motivation directly shape the quality of what ships

• Experience with people management (development talks, hiring, 1:1s) and team production (version control, stand-ups, sprints, reviews)

• You’re ready to tell us where we’re going wrong and help us improve

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**We've always believed that games are made by teams, not solo superstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. We love people who bring curiosity, generosity, flexibility, and strong opinions, especially when those opinions come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to validate ideas properly.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we're wrong.

**Practicalities

**

• We don't offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• No crunch. People over deadlines.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of coffee.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who make the team better, bring new perspectives, and will challenge us and our way of doing things!

Do you have a passion for helping clients navigate complex technology landscapes and turn architecture into a strategic advantage? Would you like to advise some of Denmark's leading brands on platform selection and future-proof architecture? If so, you may be the Senior Consultant we're looking for to join our Tech Enablement team in Copenhagen.

At Novicell, we help companies unlock their full digital potential. We combine creative thinking and technical expertise with strategic innovation to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business results. Our diverse team of specialists shares one ambition: to create outstanding customer experiences, drive growth, and challenge the boundaries of digital.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Senior Consultant in our Tech Enablement team, you will play a key role in advising our clients on platform selection, architectural considerations, and how to ensure their technology setup can truly deliver on their strategic ambitions. You will work closely with our skilled tech leads, enterprise architects, and management consultants to help client’s future-proof their setup.

**Your role will include:

**

• Advising clients on platform selection and architectural strategy across areas such as commerce, CMS, search, personalization, martech, PIM, and marketing automation

• Guiding clients through architectural approaches — including MACH, composable, mixed, and suite-based architecture — to find the right fit for their business

• Building strong business cases that help clients decide on the right technical direction, weighing cost, risk, and long-term value against their strategic ambitions

• Defining roadmaps and transition plans that guide clients from their current setup to the right technical foundation, architecture, and platforms

• Translating corporate strategy into technology roadmaps that support long-term scalability and flexibility

• Driving technical pre-sales and playing an active role in winning new clients for Novicell

• Collaborating closely with tech leads, enterprise architects, and management consultants to deliver high-impact recommendations

• Acting as a trusted advisor to clients on how to future-proof their digital setup

**Your profile

**You are strategically minded, technically fluent, and commercially aware. You enjoy translating complex technical considerations into clear, business-relevant recommendations, and you're comfortable operating at the intersection of technology and strategy.

We expect you to bring:

• 3+ years of experience as an external consultant, from an agency, digital consultancy, or similar position

• Broad knowledge of technology architecture, including MACH, composable, and suite-based approaches

• Experience advising on one or more technology areas such as commerce, CMS, search, personalization, martech, PIM, or marketing automation

• Experience with or a strong interest in technical pre-sales and business development

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and business stakeholders alike

• Curiosity and a continuous drive to learn and develop

• Fluency in Danish and English, spoken and written

**What We Offer

**At Novicell, you will step into an ambitious and professional environment where you can make a real impact. You will report directly to our Chief Strategy Officer and play a central role in advising some of the most exciting brands in Denmark and abroad on their technology strategy.

• Challenging and impactful projects from day one

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth

• Inspiring colleagues who bring expertise and ambition to every collaboration

• Freedom and flexibility to shape your workday

• A collaborative culture built on our motto "Flink & Flittig" — professionalism, helpfulness, and dedication in everything we do, paired with an informal organization, a strong social culture, and plenty of activities and events across our offices

**Practical details

**

• Location: Copenhagen.

• Applications: Welcome in English or Danish.

• We review applications continuously and will close the process once the right candidate is found

• If you have any questions, please contact Kasper Madsen at kas@novicell.dk

We look forward to receiving your application!

Read more about Novicell here

jobs.description:
R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

**About The Job

**As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our Director, BU Controlling (f/m/d) and help shape the financial performance and strategic direction of a global business. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**You will also help build and develop a high-performing global controlling community, strengthening financial capabilities across the organization while supporting business performance through coaching, governance, and matrix leadership.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive business performance through financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning that enables better decisions and profitable growth

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

• Provide clear visibility into financial performance, ensuring accurate reporting and transparency across key business metrics

• Strengthen financial governance, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and long-term value creation

**What We're Looking For

**

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

• Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders while building trusted relationships across a global matrix organization

• Experience coaching and developing finance professionals, strengthening capabilities, and driving results through influence and collaboration

**What You'll Get From Us

jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

You will get a role where relationships matter. Rather than constantly chasing the next customer, you will have the opportunity to understand a smaller number of important customers in depth and become a trusted partner in their day-to-day business.

You will be close to both customers and the internal organization, giving you a central role in turning customer needs into reliable solutions and deliveries.

Interested?

If you want to help develop the specialized container and maritime transport industry – while developing yourself professionally and personally – then we look forward to hearing from you.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. Interviews are held continuously and we will hire once we find the right candidate.

If you have questions, feel free to contact HR Manager Louise Buur at +45 21 20 44 67.

Organizational Leadership: Experience leading leaders and developing high-performing organizations.

Join Siemens Energy as a Senior Power System Engineering Specialist and lead the conceptual and system design of high-voltage substations from 72.5 kV to 420 kV for onshore and offshore projects. The role combines system design decisions in the early tender and conceptual design phase, where you take part in customer dialogues to optimize the system design, with managing the power system studies as a work package in projects. Working closely with customers, project managers and engineering experts, you define the main electrical parameters of the system. Your work turns complex technical requirements into reliable power system solutions that support the future of sustainable energy.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading system design activities for high-voltage substations, including AIS and GIS solutions for onshore and offshore applications

• Developing and reviewing single-line diagrams, electrical philosophies, interface definitions and technical concepts, and defining the main electrical parameters for transformers, reactors, switchgear and auxiliary systems

• Managing the power system studies as a work package in projects, planning which studies are needed at each stage so components can be procured with the right data

• Evaluating power system performance and ensuring compliance with grid codes, client specifications and international standards such as IEC and EN

• Collaborating with customers, certification bodies, technology suppliers and engineering teams, and driving technical decision-making and the continuous development of engineering best practices and standards

What You Bring

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience within high-voltage substation and power system engineering, including transmission substations in the 72.5 kV to 420 kV range

• Proven experience with system design, grid code compliance and power system studies for the grid connection of wind farms, for example from offshore wind, utility-scale transmission or renewable energy integration

• Strong understanding of power system behavior under normal and fault conditions, and practical experience with power transformers, shunt reactors, earthing auxiliary transformers and high-voltage switchgear technologies

• Knowledge of protection and control concepts and power system studies, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

Your profile

We expect that you are a medical doctor with the following qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.

The position is international with up to 50-60 days of travelling per year. For the ideal candidate flexibility in the workplace can be arranged.

Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Hence, we prefer that you do not add images to your application documents. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.

Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

If you are applying from North America, please know that we are committed to fair, unbiased and non-discriminatory recruitment practices and to complying with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics. For more information, please visit the official websites of the relevant authorities: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP).

Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. We offer clients the best service and highest quality in the industry.

The company is represented by more than 80 offices in 30 countries worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise. Every day, our 2,800 employees present a broad range of services, from standardised solutions delivered with optimal user and customer focus, to tailor-made projects with co-created solutions for unique customer needs.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Downstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
Join a fast-paced process development team where scientific expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving help advance projects. As Senior Scientist, you will lead downstream development activities for mammalian cell culture processes, supporting their progression through late-stage development.

You will work closely with clients, laboratory technicians and colleagues across upstream, downstream and analytical disciplines. The role combines scientific leadership, study design, data interpretation and technical writing. Most hands-on laboratory work will be performed by technicians; you will work closely with them to develop protocols, design experiments and guide execution, ensuring studies are scientifically sound and generate decision-quality data.

**A role with scientific ownership and real project impact

**As a Senior Scientist, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of downstream development activities and contribute directly to the progression of projects. You will combine your scientific expertise with practical problem-solving and collaborate with both internal colleagues and clients.

The role gives you exposure to different projects, technologies and challenges rather than focusing on one narrow area. You will be involved in shaping studies, interpreting data and turning scientific findings into clear recommendations that support project decisions.

Your work will also give you the opportunity to collaborate closely with laboratory technicians and scientists, allowing you to stay connected to the practical side of process development while taking a leading role in the scientific direction.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead and coordinate downstream development activities for assigned projects, working with clients and cross-functional teams to align on project needs and deliver outcomes.

• Plan and evaluate downstream processes, including chromatography using ÄKTA systems and filtration operations such as depth filtration, virus filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Design studies and author practical protocols in close collaboration with laboratory technicians; provide scientific guidance during experimental execution.

• Interpret study results, apply appropriate statistical approaches—including design of experiments (DoE) where relevant—and communicate findings through clear presentations and reports.

• Contribute to process characterization, including failure mode and risk assessments such as FMEA, and author process characterization (PC) work reports.

• Support investigations and deviation handling by assessing technical causes, interpreting relevant data, and documenting conclusions and follow-up actions.

• Provide scientific and technical input to business activities and support the generation of information for regulatory submissions.

**Required Qualifications And Experience

**

• Education: Master’s or PhD in Biochemistry, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, or a related discipline.

• Industrial experience: 5+ years with a Master’s degree, or 2+ years with a PhD.

• Downstream development: Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture processes.

• Unit operations: Chromatography and filtration; ideally ÄKTA systems and TFF systems.

• Study execution and data: Ability to plan, analyze and report complex development studies, including statistical analysis.

• Project work: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with scientific rigour and attention to detail.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Language: Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience

**

• Process Characterization and FMEA

• Viral clearance studies or activities.

• Commercial manufacturing requirements and biologics regulatory frameworks, including relevant ICH guidelines and BLA submission requirements.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), including experimental design, data analysis, and evaluation using SAS JMP

• Liquid-handling automation, such as Tecan systems.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**You take ownership, bring a practical can-do attitude and are comfortable working at pace. You collaborate closely with technicians and colleagues, communicate openly, and use data and sound scientific judgement to find a way forward as project needs and priorities evolve.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**We want you to have the opportunity to use your scientific expertise while continuing to develop professionally. In this role, you can expect:

• Scientific ownership: Take responsibility for development activities and influence how studies are designed and executed.

• Variety: Work across different projects, technologies and scientific challenges rather than doing the same thing every day.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with scientists, technicians, upstream and analytical colleagues as well as clients.

• Client exposure: Develop your ability to communicate scientific findings and recommendations directly with clients and contribute to project discussions.

• Professional development: Continue developing your expertise in downstream processing, process characterization, data analysis and late-stage development.

• Impact: See how your scientific work contributes to advancing biopharmaceutical processes towards later-stage development and manufacturing.

**A team where science and collaboration go hand in hand

**You will become part of a team where scientific knowledge, practical experience and collaboration are important to how we work. We value people who share knowledge, ask questions and are willing to challenge and support each other.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues across different disciplines, giving you the opportunity to learn from others while also bringing your own expertise to the team.

We believe that good science is strengthened by open communication, different perspectives and a willingness to find solutions together.

**Ready to make your next move?

**If you are looking for a role where you can combine scientific expertise, project ownership, client interaction and practical problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through the AGC Biologics career site by **31 October 2026.

**Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system and cannot accept CVs by email.

**The Recruitment Process Will Include

**

• An initial screening interview with People & Culture

• An interview with the Hiring Manager

• A final interview, including a cognitive assessment and personality assessment

• A meet and greet with team members and a laboratory tour

• Reference checks

Applications will be reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We may close the position before the application deadline once the right candidate has been identified.

_Location: We can only consider candidates currently based in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area, as relocation support is not available for this position.

_At AGC Biologics, we are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. We assess candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role.

To support an objective recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your application or CV.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Product Coordinator - Data, structure, and coordination at the heart of our largest product category.
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to complexity? Do you take pride in keeping track of details, data, and deadlines? Then you could be the Coordinator we are looking for in our Incontinence and baby diapers team at ABENA!

Incontinence and baby diapers are ABENA's largest product category. At the same time, we are welcoming new digital and innovative product areas into the team, creating exciting opportunities but also increasing the need for structure and coordination. That's why we are looking for a new colleague who can help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

This is a role with a very broad range of responsibilities. One day you might be updating master data, checking marketing materials, working with price lists, or creating Excel reports. The next day you could be following up on backorders, supporting a product launch, or helping solve an unexpected operational challenge. New tasks will constantly land on your desk, so it's important that you enjoy variety and take pride in bringing order to complexity.

Simply put, you are the person who puts things on track and helps keep the train moving.

You can expect your main tasks to include:

• Maintain product information and master data across our systems.

• Support new product launches and help coordinate activities across departments.

• Follow up on backorders and product availability, keeping Sales updated.

• Create reports and work with product, pricing, and sales data in Excel.

• Support process improvements, data clean-up, and documentation of workflows.

• Prepare project updates, newsletters, and other communication for internal stakeholders.

We hope you bring:

• A relevant education within business, administration, supply chain, marketing, or a related field.

• An interest in working with product data, reports, and master data, along with a willingness to learn new systems.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and keep track of many moving parts.

• Confidence working in Excel and a curiosity for turning data into useful insights.

• A proactive and helpful mindset, with a genuine desire to support colleagues and contribute wherever needed.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

Our team brings together five complementary experts in product management, sourcing, and compliance. We’re driven by a genuine passion for our work and a deep commitment to our category and products. We support one another, celebrate our successes together, and ensure we thrive as a team.

Your leader at ABENA will be Group Concept Manager Birgitte Hausted, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“I adapt my leadership style to the people and teams I work with, and I always meet others with respect for their expertise and strengths. I don’t see failure as losing. I see it as learning and getting better together. Trust and transparency matter a lot to me, and I believe we do our best work when we reflect on and grow as a team.”

Your workplace will be located at the ABENA Headquarter in Aabenraa, Denmark.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: To make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. We combine professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. We take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness, and cooperation. These values shape how we lead, support one another, and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

We look forward to receiving your application

If you are interested in the position, please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We process applications as we receive them, and we close the search when we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you would like further information about the job, please feel free to contact Birgitte Hausted, Group Concept Manager, on +45 5158 0484.
